m: Escape the Council Hall ✓ Neutralise the enforcers
Council Enforcer (broad) slain (still standing at victory — resolved to the narration)
Quest Escape the Council Hall: completed
Clock reconciled to 'early morning' +120m → Day 2, 8:00 am
Condition: Guidance active on Corvath Denn

guidance.effect: target adds 1d4 to one ability check of its choice before the spell ends

Nia Ulvane.firstEncounter:
"Hello. I'm a healer. Don't move."

Your voice carries flat across the mud. No echo. The wind eats it.

A figure slumps against the doorframe. Adult, by the size. Wrapped in something that used to be a coat.

Osric Whitlock.firstEncounter:
"You have somewhere to sleep? Something to eat?"

She laughs. One short, ugly sound.

"Had a room above Norvan's cooperage. He burned the floor for fuel two weeks back. Sleeps down with the barrels now, says I can too." She pauses. "Soup most nights.

Corva Flinthallow.firstEncounter:
Dawn comes grey and grudging. Nia is still breathing. You leave her the last of the flask and step outside.

Duskbridge in the morning is not improved by light.

The Ashfield quarter is already moving.

events.note: Directed Sera to Cutter's Row: old weaver woman, two dock workers with frostbite, and a young girl with a bad cough. Mentioned Corva checking her hands since her husband died.

Bramble Ironside.firstEncounter:
"Deal," you say. "Sit down."

He sits on the threshold. You open the kit.

The wound is bad but not as bad as Nia's. Shallower. Less time. You clean it, probe the yellow edges, cut away what needs cutting. He makes one sound, sharp and bitten off, then goes quiet.

Yrindel Ashvane.firstEncounter:
Guidance helps a creature make an ability check. Corva isn't making a check. You are.

And you've already stepped away from her door, moving toward the coughing.

The spell won't diagnose her from two buildings away. It won't do anything useful right now.

Toldun Duskmantle.firstEncounter:
"Where does this quarter get fuel? Anyone still selling?"

Yrindel's mouth tightens. "Norvan had wood. Burned most of it himself." She shakes her head. "Bramble Ironside sometimes knows where to find things. He's good at finding things."

You already know Bramble.

Sable Wyndfall.firstEncounter:
He's already at the shutter. Barely moved, just shifted weight, one eye at the gap. Quiet as a man who's done this before.

A long moment. The fire ticks. Toldun doesn't breathe.

"Two men," Bramble says. Low. "Near the cooper's yard. Not working.

Palyn Yarwick.firstEncounter:
She thinks. Picks at the hem of her sleeve.

"Palyn Yarwick and her sister. They've been there since the flooding." A pause. "Palyn's sister has the cough. Bad one. Same as the others started."

Your stomach tightens.

"Who else?"

"An old man. Rendal. Came in late autumn.

Vorindel Pallwick.firstEncounter:
"What's in the case?"

No preamble. No pleasantries. You're standing ten feet from her and you've got ash on your tongue and no patience left.

She doesn't flinch. Points to you, actually. Relaxed about it.

"I was going to ask you the same thing." Her eyes are on your kit.

Tinkwick Wyndfall.firstEncounter: The Council hall sits at Duskbridge's north end. Stone. Newer than everything around it.

Physician Duskmantle.firstEncounter:
The hall is stone and cold and quiet in the way buildings are quiet when people are trying not to be heard.

Third door on the left.

You push it open.

The smell hits first. Not rot exactly. Something fungal and close, like turned earth in a sealed room.

Wraith Lorrath.firstEncounter:
Sixty feet. He's within range.

You turn. Plant your feet on the bridge approach. Speak the word.

Radiant light falls clean and cold from nothing.

It takes him full across the chest. No cover helps. No dodge saves him.

Corvath Denn.firstEncounter:
Bramble isn't the one negotiating.

You are.

He reads your hesitation. "Go. I'll be here." He shifts his weight off the bad leg. Leans against the doorframe.

lore: Cutter's Row building holds at least three families Osric has been sheltering. Notable cases: elderly weaver, two dock workers with frostbite, young girl with persistent cough.
Corva Flinthallow and Toldun Duskmantle's husbands both died around the same time, chest illness, having been moved from the river quarter into the same building by Osric Whitlock
The Elder Council sent assessors to inquire about the building where Corva and Toldun's husbands died, the same morning Sera arrived in the quarter
Sable Wyndfall runs errands for hire, last known connection to Osric Whitlock
Council assessors report same-day; if the two men left immediately, the Elder Council already has a full account of the building and its occupants
The Council physician privately named the spreading sickness 'Vantel's Rot'; not recorded in any official report
The Council physician's name is Duskmantle — same family name as Toldun Duskmantle, whose husband died in the blighted building
Physician Duskmantle shares the family name Duskmantle with Toldun Duskmantle, whose husband died in the blighted building.
Physician Duskmantle reported the grain spore findings to Elder Marne directly. Marne suppressed the report. Duskmantle has been confined and untreated since.
Rot originates from contaminated grain. Spores entered storage, walls, and breathed air over winter. Once in the lungs, they do not clear.
Vantel's Rot was named before Duskmantle ever diagnosed it. The name came with the grain strain documentation itself.
Oakhallow coordinated the same contaminated grain strain across six settlements in the Reach, not just Duskbridge; someone inside the Church reassigned him and moved his files after deaths began
Corvath Denn has been sitting on the suspicion that someone inside the Church deliberately cleaned the trail; he has not acted on it
The five other settlements receiving the same grain strain have gone silent; no replies to Corvath's letters since Oakhallow disappeared

Council is concealing at least seventeen confirmed deaths in Duskbridge's river quarter as of October; Corvath estimates hundreds dead across all six settlements by spring if the blight has progressed similarly elsewhere

Three grain storage locations in Duskbridge: sealed north road granary under Council control since November, two merchant quarter stores with newer unblighted stock, one leased under Corvath Denn's name
Oakhallow's private letter described the grain strain as showing unexpected pathogenic properties in cold storage and instructed Denn to exercise discretion regarding source documentation
